title: 第130章 卡班哈是不是疯了？！
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林恩和卡斯托尔共同赶往指挥室，卡尔加和各位连长和士官们已经在这里开始开会。

恶魔和混沌舰队来袭了。

灵族死神军一直在盯着混沌舰队的动向，通过网道秘密通道，情报以人类无法达到的速度源源不断地传到极限战士这边。

最新一条消息是恶魔舰队已经逼近了奥特拉玛星域，马上就要到达这里。

卡班哈这次就是冲极限战士和基里曼来的，它要大开杀戒，要在奥特拉玛的地面上，用原体的血，浇灌恐虐的祭坛。

虽然奥特拉玛没有大天使，但基里曼是圣吉列斯最亲的兄弟，同样也是值得猎杀的猎物。

卡尔加捏紧了拳头，咬住后槽牙。

他为他们的基因原体被如此轻视而感到愤怒。

准备迎战。

极限战士一定会粉碎恐虐的这支恶魔大军，让所有恶魔都为它们的轻视付出代价。

极限战士决定在普兰迪姆迎敌。

是的，普兰迪姆。

就是刚刚在贝西摩斯虫族入侵中被吃空了的奥特拉玛明珠。

在太空轨道迎敌的话，恶魔不需要呼吸，而人类需要。

在太空中对战恶魔，永远是人类劣势。如果动力甲被损坏，人类在太空中几分钟就会因为窒息而死。

所以还不如由极限战士自己挑个不重要的星球表面，直接跟它们地面对垒，如果劣势了的话，轨道舰队还能直接开启轨道轰炸。

好就好在这一波是恐虐大魔卡班哈为首。

卡班哈喜欢正面对抗，地面对敌就地面对敌，不喜欢弄什么阴谋诡计，所以它们一定会前往极限战士准备的正面战场。

选普兰迪姆不是随便选的，选在这里迎战恶魔主要有两个好处。

一是普兰迪姆位于奥特拉玛的边境，再加上这里已经变成了荒星，选在这里交战不会太过于影响星球的环境，也不会有平民伤亡。

因为周围没人所以打起来不用束手束脚，什么武器都能用，什么战术都能上，不管是宏炮还是光矛，不管是轨道轰炸还是烈焰焚烧。

二是普兰迪姆是曾经的花园星，虽然现在星球被吃空了，但是大气层还在，大气一时半会不会消散，这里还有空气，适合战士们对战恶魔，就算动力甲被毁坏，也不会出现什么危险，还能继续呼吸。

要找一个这种有适合人类呼吸的大气层，还要是个荒星的宜居星还真不容易。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Linn and Castor rushed to the command room together, where Calga and the company commanders and non-commissioned officers had already started a meeting.

Daemons and Chaos fleets are coming.

The Eldar Death Army has been keeping an eye on the movements of the Chaos Fleet. Through the secret passages of the Webway, information is continuously transmitted to the Ultramarines at a speed that humans cannot achieve.

The latest news is that the demon fleet has approached the Ultramar star field and will arrive here soon.

Ka'banha is coming for the Ultramarines and Guilliman this time. It wants to go on a killing spree and use the blood of the original body to water the altar of Khorne on the ground of Ultramar.

Although there are no archangels in Ultramar, Guilliman is Sanguinius's closest brother, and he is also a worthy prey.

Calga clenched her fists and bit her back molars.

He was angry that their Primarch was so slighted.

Be prepared to fight.

The Ultramarines will crush Khorne's daemon army and make all daemons pay for their slights.

The Ultramarines decided to face the enemy at Plandium.

Yes, Prentice.

It was the Pearl of Ultramar that had just been eaten up by the Behemoth Zerg invasion.

When facing enemies in orbit, demons don't need to breathe, but humans do.

When fighting against demons in space, humans will always be at a disadvantage.If the power armor is damaged, humans will die of suffocation in space within a few minutes.

So it would be better for the Ultramarines to pick an unimportant planet surface and confront them directly on the ground. If they are at a disadvantage, the orbital fleet can also directly launch orbital bombing.

Fortunately, this wave is led by the Great Demon of Khorne, Kabanha.

Kabanha likes head-on confrontation, facing the enemy on the ground, and does not like any intrigues, so they will definitely go to the frontal battlefield prepared by the Ultramarines.

Choosing Plandim is not a random choice. There are two main benefits of choosing to fight the devil here.

First, Plandim is located on the border of Ultramar, and it has become a deserted star. Choosing to fight here will not affect the planet's environment too much, and there will be no civilian casualties.

Because there is no one around, you don't have to restrain your hands when fighting. You can use any weapons and tactics, whether it's macro cannons or light spears, orbital bombardment or blazing incineration.

Second, Plandim was the former Garden Planet. Although the planet is now emptied, the atmosphere is still there. Will the atmosphere dissipate for a while? There is still air here, suitable for warriors to fight against demons. Even if the power armor is destroyed, there will be no danger and they can continue to breathe.

It is really not easy to find a livable star that has an atmosphere suitable for human beings to breathe and is also a desolate star.
